_doc: M10-T15 (Q20, Q53; docs/assets-capital.md 'Mines'): the three mine kinds' numbers and how a hull lays them in battle. kinds: trigger_m from the hull's surface, body_m what a touch must reach, arm_s before a laid mine's trigger works, dormant_s a guided mine lies idle, speed_mps its flight or homing speed, home_m the range a guided mine homes from, fuse_s after an energy mine arrives before it goes off whatever is near (0: never), capitals_only, turn_rad_s a guided mine's turn rate, toughness the interceptor pulses a flying mine takes, radar_m how close a hostile mine shows on the radar (own and friendly always); the blast is the BlastTable source of the same name (capitals.json 'blasts'). laying: per kind, what a mount does: it looks for a hostile it perceives between range_min_m and range_m within cone_deg of its forward, lays count mines every cycle_s (never more than max_in_play of that kind from the ship), a mine leaving at drop_mps along forward, clearance_m in front of the mount. mount_kinds: the hardpoints' `mine` mounts take the kind of their weapon id in loadouts.json.
